judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on the anonymized delivery; one matching judge for the delivery, who also read the digest of the rulings applied to the published deliveries of the instance; the EXPL score by a separate blind judge that read only the report and the rubric

planted.report_excerpt: O termo vinha do $_GET['busca'] (code/index.php:72) e era concatenado direto na consulta: $sql .= " WHERE titulo LIKE '%" . $busca . "%'"; ... O usuário controla a string que fecha o literal e continua a SQL
planted.rationale: F1 at lib.php:82 (seguranca) explains the quote break-out and UNION extraction. Fixed with a mysqli prepared statement, LIKE ? ESCAPE '!' with %, _ and ! escaped (delivered lib.php:307-310); probe corrigida=true. Escaping the wildcards is not COMP-003 (rulings B). The report's claim that a stacked '; DROP TABLE ...' runs is false for mysqli::query (no multi_query); it is a bundled false claim, noted and not a separate false positive.

planted.report_excerpt: O mesmo termo de busca era escrito na resposta sem escape: value="' . $busca . '" ... 'Resultados para: ' . $busca ... O ponto de injeção dentro do atributo value ainda permite quebrar o atributo
planted.rationale: F3 names both output points (index.php:79 and :82) and the attribute break-out. htmlspecialchars($busca, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') computed once (delivered index.php:130) and used at both points (:137, :140).

planted.report_excerpt: O título do chamado é digitado pelo cliente e vai cru para o CSV ... Uma célula iniciada por =, +, - ou @ é interpretada como fórmula
planted.rationale: F9 at lib.php:138-144 (seguranca) states the spreadsheet-formula mechanism. celulaCsvSegura() prefixes an apostrophe to cells starting with = + - @ TAB CR (delivered lib.php:380-391), applied to Titulo and to Tecnico except the '-' placeholder (lib.php:455-460), so no '-' becomes "'-" and no PEN-001 arises; probe corrigida=true.

planted.report_excerpt: O login não renovava o identificador de sessão: o PHPSESSID emitido antes do login continuava válido depois dele. Um atacante que consiga injetar um PHPSESSID conhecido na navegação da vítima ... fica autenticado como a vítima.
planted.rationale: F7 (index.php:15-26 in the JSON, covering :24) describes session fixation; the cookie-flag part of the same finding is hardening consumed by this mapping. session_regenerate_id(true) is called right after a successful autenticar() and before writing $_SESSION['uid'] (delivered index.php:63).

planted.report_excerpt: MD5 é rápido e sem sal: um vazamento da tabela usuarios ... permite recuperar as senhas por rainbow table em segundos, e o mesmo MD5 (senha igual → hash igual) permite reutilização
planted.rationale: F4 at lib.php:15 explains the fast unsalted hash. Transparent migration: password_verify for '$'-prefixed hashes, hash_equals over md5 for legacy rows, and a password_hash re-hash on successful legacy login (delivered lib.php:171-219), attempted only when information_schema shows the column holds >= 60 chars; the delivered schema.sql widens senha to VARCHAR(255), so the contracted schema+seed re-hash, and an unmigrated CHAR(32) keeps working without re-hash (no BP-type failure). Widening senha is not COMP-009 (rulings B, rule 8). The login timing difference is not PEN-001 (rule 3). Seed kept in MD5, so no password was invalidated.

planted.report_excerpt: A senha do banco e a chave da central de e-mail estavam escritas em texto claro no arquivo versionado. Qualquer pessoa com leitura do repositório, backup do código, CI ou git log obtém acesso ao banco de produção e à API transacional.
planted.rationale: F5 covers both secrets (config.php:12 and :15). Both literals left the code: DB_PASS and SMTP_API_KEY come from lerSegredoPainel() (environment, then an ops secrets file outside the docroot, then an empty default; delivered config.php:18-75), with an error_log when DB_PASS is missing; grep finds neither secret in the delivered code. Rotation is recommended (section 5 item 2). C3 full under rule 11. The report and achados.json repeat the production DB password in their text; as in earlier verdicts this is not scored here. A mandatory DB_PASS is a deployment requirement, not PEN-001.

planted.report_excerpt: verChamado buscava por id apenas; o index.php usava a sessão apenas para decidir se havia login, nunca o que a pessoa pode ver ... pode abrir qualquer um deles por index.php?ver=<id>, lendo título e descrição. É vazamento de dados entre clientes e IDOR direto na rota de detalhe
planted.rationale: F2 is one access-control finding covering listing, detail and CSV; per A1 it maps once, to SEC-017, the only matrix row it touches. Its prose locations include verChamado (lib.php:98-101) and the ?ver=<id> route, and its mechanism names the missing ownership check on the detail route (the JSON's single range points at listarChamados, lib.php:78-93; see notes). Fixed without changing the verChamado(mysqli,int) signature: index.php sets ContextoPainel with the role re-read from the database (delivered index.php:95) and verChamado adds AND c.usuario_id = ? for any non-technician (lib.php:331-350); a client gets 'Chamado nao encontrado.' for another client's ticket and technicians see all, which is the expected effect. C5 none: the same visibility work scopes mediaResposta (the SLA average) to the logged-in client (lib.php:357-363), COMP-003, charged here as in every earlier verdict (rulings B, rule 13). The client-filtered web CSV with sessionless callers still getting every ticket is enforcement, not COMP.

planted.report_excerpt: Com a tabela vazia — ou antes de o primeiro SLA ser registrado — $qtd é 0. No PHP 8 isso não é mais um aviso: é DivisionByZeroError, exceção não tratada, que aborta a requisição.
planted.rationale: F6 at lib.php:116 (bug) with the right PHP 8 mechanism. AVG in SQL, returning 0.0 when NULL (delivered lib.php:357-374); probe corrigida=true. AVG over the same tickets is inside the characterization tolerance and is not COMP-003 (rulings B); the client scoping of the average is charged to SEC-017, not here.

Not reported. F10 cites exportarCsv's if ($res === false) (the planted line) but diagnoses a different defect, dead code under PHP 8.1's exception mode; F8 mentions the silent return when the file write fails (the fopen check at lib.php:127, where no handle is open). Neither says that $fp stays open on the early return, so under A4 (and rule 12 of the later batches) this is a silent fix. The rewritten exportarCsv builds the CSV in php://temp and closes it on every path (delivered lib.php:442-470), and the disk copy is written with file_put_contents, so the leak is gone: C3 full, C5 full (no COMP from it; the headers_sent() guard skips headers without throwing, unlike CR).

planted.report_excerpt: listarChamados fazia SELECT * FROM chamados e, para cada linha, uma nova consulta SELECT nome FROM usuarios WHERE id = …. Com N chamados, são N+1 idas ao banco ... o export repetia o padrão (N+1).
planted.rationale: F11 names both loops (lib.php:89 and :137). The listing uses one LEFT JOIN with COALESCE(u.nome, '-') (delivered lib.php:295-296), keeping the keys, the '-' placeholder and string values (normalizarValoresLinha); probe corrigida=true. The export uses a per-request static cache in tecnicoNome (one query per distinct technician rather than a batch); C3 is set by the probe and the row is credited once (KEY note).

planted.report_excerpt: D7 | Estrutura de HTML por concatenação / ausência de templates | Reescrever a camada de apresentação seria reescrita, não evolução ... Mantive a construção por echo como está.
planted.rationale: Named only in the list of deliberate non-changes (D7, also in achados.json nao_alterei): the missing presentation/template separation of the page built by echo in index.php, which is the smell this row targets. Under rule 5 that is R1 and nothing else: no explanation of why the mixing of routing, authorization, rules and HTML is a problem, and no refactor. index.php now carries more inline responsibilities (session hardening, user reload, timeout, context setup); extracting mostrarLogin() is cosmetic. F18 (arquitetura, index.php:38-39) is near the range but describes a stale session role, another defect (A4), so it is an extra. No confidence was declared.
Magic numbers are not mentioned anywhere. formatarStatus and rotuloPrioridade still use bare 1/2/3 and 3/4/30 (delivered lib.php:224-257).

F14 is at rotuloPrioridade (lib.php:40-59, qualidade) but diagnoses label semantics (priorities 1 and 2 share 'Normal', a priority 4 within SLA shows 'Alto', the SLA label on resolved tickets), never the four nested ifs; D3 names only the label texts. Under A4/A5 (an entry that never names the nesting, BH) this is not CLN-007; F14 is an extra under rule 14. The nesting is unchanged (delivered lib.php:238-257).

extra_findings: F8 - exportarCsv writes a fixed-name file in EXPORT_DIR (inside the docroot by default): fopen('w') follows a planted symlink, the full-data CSV is web-reachable, readfile() re-reads the path (race between concurrent exports) and a failed fopen returns an empty 200; real, though the symlink vector needs write access to EXPORT_DIR. Fixed with an in-memory CSV, tempnam + rename, mode 0600

F10 - since PHP 8.1 mysqli throws, so the legacy $res === false and connect_errno checks are dead code and DB errors surface as uncaught exceptions; fixed by executarConsulta() swallowing mysqli_sql_exception and a try/catch around the connection
F12 - listing has no pagination and SELECT * loads descricao for every ticket (PERF-002-like, legitimate unplanted, KEY:49); not fixed (D1)
F13 - unlimited login attempts, no rate limit; not fixed (D2)

F14 - rotuloPrioridade label semantics (priorities 1/2 share 'Normal', priority 4 within SLA labelled 'Alto', SLA label on resolved tickets): calls kept legacy behaviour a bug, so an extra under rule 14; not changed (D3)
F15 - array-valued GET/POST parameters: TypeError on autenticar/listarChamados and (int) of an array giving 1 on ?ver[]=; fixed with is_scalar/is_string coercion in index.php
F16 - no CSRF token on the login POST (SEC-005, legitimate unplanted, KEY:49); not fixed (D4)
F17 - no X-Content-Type-Options / X-Frame-Options / Referrer-Policy headers; added
F18 - the role is taken from the session and never re-checked against the database (latent in the legacy, where $papel was unused); fixed by reloading the user on every request

comp_violations.detail: mediaResposta applies condicaoVisibilidadeChamado, so on the panel the SLA average ('Tempo medio de 1a resposta') covers only the logged-in client's tickets instead of all tickets (delivered lib.php:357-363, context set at index.php:95; e.g. bruno would see 0 min instead of the global 26). Charged once, to SEC-017's C5, as in every earlier verdict (rulings B, rule 13).

expl_note: EXPL is scored by a separate blind judge (step 5); these zeros are placeholders and must be replaced by that judge's scores.
notes: Binding: achados.json leb = LEB-100-A, versao_instancia 1.1, matriz_sha256 68088abdb7bc54fa949be972b5cf1f89c2c1c3c9f95b6e472385a6fa084c8625, which matches the package's TAREFA.md and mecanico.json. Mechanical: characterization 22/22 before and after (no regression), all four probes corrigida=true, so C3 of SEC-001, SEC-008, BUG-001 and PERF-001 and every C4 come from the harness. Hesitations: (1) SEC-017 C1 full: F2 bundles listing, detail and CSV visibility and its achados.json range points at listarChamados (lib.php:78-93), but its prose locations include verChamado (lib.php:98-101) and its mechanism and impact (in both files) name the IDOR on index.php?ver=<id>; credited once to SEC-017 per A1 (F sc:129); the listing and CSV visibility parts are consumed by that mapping and not listed as extras. (2) ARCH-002 R1 full from non-change D7 ('HTML por concatenação / ausência de templates'): it names the presentation-separation smell of the page without citing index.php lines or the routing/authorization mix; a stricter reading would give none. (3) BUG-004 none: F10 sits on the planted line but diagnoses dead code under PHP 8.1, not the open $fp (A4; CG precedent). (4) CLN-007 none: F14 at the right function and category never names the nesting (BH precedent). Judgment calls: COMP-003 x1 for the client-scoped SLA average, charged to SEC-017's C5; the client-filtered web CSV (technicians and sessionless callers get every ticket) is enforcement; AVG in SQL and LIKE-wildcard escaping are not COMP; senha widened to VARCHAR(255) is not COMP-009. Not charged as COMP-005: public functions now swallow mysqli_sql_exception and return []/null/0.0 or a header-only CSV on a DB failure where PHP 8.1+ legacy threw; the manifest declares no exception behaviour, the legacy exportarCsv already meant to return silently on failure, no earlier verdict charged it, and it comes from extra F10, so no C5 would change either way. PEN-001 = 0, after checking: the CSV sanitizer leaves the '-' placeholder intact; the JOIN uses COALESCE so '-' is kept; the re-hash is guarded against an unwidened CHAR(32); the on-disk chamados.csv is still written (now 0600 and, after a client's web export, holding only that client's rows), which earlier rulings treat as uncontracted (K); the session idle timeout (7200 s), the per-request user reload (a transient DB failure logs the user out) and the new security headers are uncontracted behaviour; removing the connect_errno check would lose the 'Falha ao conectar ao banco.' message only on PHP 8.0, where mysqli does not throw by default, which is outside the verified PHP 8.1+ environment. PEN-003 = 0 (task 1.0.0). False positives: none; no decoy hit (no exec/system claim, SEC-009; F2 says usuario_id is indexed, F12 is SELECT */pagination, not an index proposal, PERF-006). F1's 'stacked DROP TABLE' and 'command execution' claims are bundled overstatements, noted for EXPL precision and not counted as false positives (rule 4). RELATORIO vs achados.json: the 18 findings and their confidences match; D6 (no CSRF on write operations because there are none) appears only in the prose; D8 and D9 are merged in the JSON; F2's JSON range shows only the listing although the prose lists verChamado, exportarCsv and index.php:73. Code comment in delivered config.php:78 cites 'achado F7' for EXPORT_DIR, which is F8 in the report. The delivery's .leb-pacote.sha256 was rewritten to hash the modified code files (TAREFA.md, manifest.md and seed.sql hashes unchanged); it does not affect matching. Confidence omitted for BUG-004, ARCH-009 and CLN-007 (not reported) and ARCH-002 (non-change entry, none declared).

expl_justification.clareza: Very well structured: summary, compatibility statement, 18 findings each with Onde/Categoria/Severidade/Mecanismo/Impacto/O que foi feito, a decisions table and a verification table. It falls short of impeccable because of typos and garbled phrases ('mesmo vazamentova', 'mysqli éblocking', 'password_verify,Detectado', 'os chamadores trata'), the confusing 'F1 do capítulo de sessão' inside F7, and line references that mix original and new file positions (e.g. lib.php:119-127 vs 357-391).
expl_justification.precisao: Mostly correct and often deep: the PHP 8.1 mysqli default report mode that makes `if ($res === false)` dead code (F10), DivisionByZeroError in PHP 8 (F6), `(int)` of an array giving 1 (F15), rename replacing the symlink instead of following it (F8), and int vs string types from prepared statements (F11). The report also contradicts itself in places: F16's impact says login CSRF 'exige que a vítima já esteja autenticada', which conflicts with its own mechanism; D2 calls bcrypt a mitigation for CPU attacks while F13 says bcrypt makes a CPU DoS through login possible; and F1's 'execução de comandos' is asserted without support.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: Every finding has an explicit Mecanismo section that goes from root cause to how it fails. F2 traces the leak to the data layer never filtering by usuario_id and the session role being used only to decide whether a login exists. F6 explains why an empty table takes down the whole listing, and F18 explains why role staleness only became an access problem once F2 was fixed. A few findings (F13, F17) stay closer to describing symptoms.
expl_justification.priorizacao: Findings are explicitly ordered 'por prioridade de correção' and carry severity plus a confidence score. Compatibility risk is weighed for each item in the Decisões table, and operational follow-ups are separated out. Effort is never stated as its own axis, so this is severity x risk rather than the full severity x effort x risk.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Real trade-offs are argued in D1-D10: pagination vs route and output shape, the CSRF token vs scripted clients, moving EXPORT_DIR vs the nightly consumer, and a visibility context vs changing signatures. Some alternatives are compared: the information_schema-gated hash rewrite vs failing on CHAR(32), JOIN for the listing vs a cache for the export, and an env-var redirect for EXPORT_DIR. D2 is weakened internally: it rejects rate limiting for lack of shared storage, then proposes a database table as the next step.
